item.summary: perf(ui): stop running full setup detection on every Control UI connect (#128135) The first-run gate was paying 5.5s warm / 16.8s cold and retaining roughly 216MB to compute setupComplete. Record the default agent's model-configured fact in the hello snapshot and make the UI redirect decision synchronously from that fact.
